title: Stronger-response live MODFLOW affine slope-policy invariance

baseline.fixture: F-GC44 configured real SWAP + live MODFLOW6 E3-R geometry

fixed_case.reason: This preregistered E3-R case had the largest already-recorded loose-to-iterative head correction in the 24-case E3-R matrix while remaining fully convergent under the unchanged component envelope.

slope_policies.name: CURRENT_PLUS_U
slope_policies.rule: Use the configured production HCOF returned by F-GC44/F-GC33.

slope_policies.name: E4_B3_CORRECTOR_JR
slope_policies.rule: HCOF=A*J_R/window_day using the independently qualified E4 B3 plateau estimate.

common_initial_point: All variants pass through the same configured production (H_ref,q_ref) before the first MODFLOW solve.
iteration_contract: Use the unchanged E3-R zero-background-gradient MODFLOW model.
For each policy start a fresh real SWAP fixture and fresh MODFLOW prepared solve from the same accepted origins.
After each MODFLOW solve, run the unchanged real SWAP prescribed-head corrector and evaluate q_swap-q_groundwater.
If the conjunctive gate is not closed, discard the candidate and reanchor only RHS while retaining the policy HCOF.
On convergence publish MODFLOW once, commit the SWAP candidate once and commit the interface ledger once.
gates: The CURRENT_PLUS_U variant reproduces the already qualified E3-R B3 K=0.1 case within the existing residual and envelope.
All three policies converge within 40 coupling outer iterations without changing any SWAP or MODFLOW tolerance.
Each final coupled residual is <=1e-15 m/s.
Each variant commits exactly one SWAP candidate and one ledger entry.
Each ledger equals q_swap_final*window_seconds within 1e-12 m.
Pairwise final accepted head spread <=5e-10 m, a bound fixed before execution at the same order as the 1e-15 m/s residual tolerance divided by the independently qualified B3 response scale.
interpretation_rules: If all policies preserve accepted physical state but work differs, slope remains an iteration-policy object in this stronger response regime.
If E4_B3_CORRECTOR_JR materially reduces work relative to CURRENT_PLUS_U, report the bounded numerical advantage without generalizing beyond this regime.
If a policy changes accepted state beyond fixed gates despite satisfying the same coupled residual/publication contract, classify a coupling-algorithm dependency and stop before production changes.
A failed policy is retained as evidence; do not relax component or coupling tolerances.
forbidden: no widening of the corrector envelope
no performance claim beyond this one B3/K=0.1 case
